info.name: Flink JobManager REST Cluster Savepoint Disposal API

items.docs: Triggers the desposal of a savepoint. This async operation would return a 'triggerid' for further query identifier.

params.name: triggerid
params.description: 32-character hexadecimal string that identifies an asynchronous operation trigger ID. The ID was returned then the operation was triggered.

items.docs: Returns the status of a savepoint disposal operation.
